findings.message: Catalog entry is not typed prof:ResourceDescriptor, so it escapes the descriptor contract (no role/label/conformsTo/installedBy enforced).
findings.remediation: Add 'a prof:ResourceDescriptor' plus prof:hasRole, rdfs:label, dct:conformsTo, wiki:installedBy to bring it under governance.
